core_change_summary.description: In DYYY.xm, a single-file iOS tweak, multiple view classes were modified to cache subview references (e.g., sidebar badges, alpha subviews, avatar subviews, fullscreen button subviews, tab bar cached views, search indicator, story slide components, comment container). The changes introduce cached properties to avoid repeated dynamic view lookups.
